messages:
Erin: quick follow-up from the kernel RFC sync — thanks everyone for the run-through. want to capture the concrete next steps for triton vs CUTLASS paths and the attention micro-optimizations we discussed. TL;DR: protos+bench harness first, then adapter surface, then CI/rollout plan.
Sanjay: +1. I can own the microbench harness for attention variants (causal, prefix, kv-cache heavy). will do perf and quality (logit bias / numerical diffs) across fp16/int8. ETA end of next week.
Kevin: can we make the adapter surface minimal? proposal: runtime exposes a KernelVTable with: `init`, `forward_step`, `kv_swap`, `shutdown`. that should let triton and cutlass implement without touching higher layers.
Mike: re CI, we'll need perf gates and golden prompts for quality checks. I can wire a nightly job and a perf dashboard. recommend thresholds: latency regression <5% and p95 token latency within 1.2x baseline.
Erin: Kevin — that KernelVTable looks good. couple followups: (1) fallback semantics: sync vs async fallback? we favoured async so callers aren't blocked, but need queueing/backpressure rules. (2) versioning: add a `kernel_version` string so we can route by capability.
Kevin: async fallback makes sense. i'll add a `fallback_policy` enum to the vtable metadata: {NO_FALLBACK, SYNC_FALLBACK, ASYNC_FALLBACK}. For `kernel_version` we'll use semver-like tag e.g., `cutlass-1.2.0` / `triton-0.9.4`.
Sanjay: for bench harness: sample command to run per-model workload: ```./bench_attention --model gpt-3-small --seq 1024 --batch 8 --mode causal --kernel triton``` will collect latency, throughput, memory, and per-token logits to diff. will publish CSVs to the perf bucket.
Mike: deploy-bot just posted the perf infra skeleton build: <https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7421|build/7421> :rocket: I wired the dashboard template at /dashboards/attention-kernel.
Erin: action items recap: 1) Sanjay: microbench harness + quality diffs (due 2026-04-04) 2) Kevin: implement KernelVTable sketch + fallback_policy and versioning (due 2026-03-31) 3) Mike: CI job + perf dashboard + perf gates (due 2026-04-07) 4) Erin: write short runbook for rollout (canary thresholds, fallback routing) (due 2026-04-06). please update the RFC PR with links to artifacts when ready.
Kevin: I'll push the vtable prototype to `repos/runtime` under `kernel/iface` and add a toy triton shim.
Sanjay: will upload initial harness CSVs to `s3://redwood-perf/attention/triage/` and add a README with how to reproduce.
Mike: I'll add the perf gate check to `ci/perf-checks` and a slack alert for regressions.
Erin: one risk callout — memory-backed kv-cache formats differ between triton kernels and CUTLASS kernels; we may need a tiny compatibility shim for on-disk migration. putting that as a blocker if we discover incompatible layouts during benching.
Sanjay: noted. i'll include a kv-cache compatibility check in the harness.
Erin: ok, thanks all. i'll follow up in the RFC PR with these tasks and tag owners. if anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
